content:
saira: quick async check — i'm planning to add an optional top-level "call_flow" hint to the chat/completions response (and streaming deltas). idea is to let clients know whether the model is about to invoke an external tool vs continue text. would that break any existing SDK behavior?

kevin: curious — how is this different from the current "function_call" signal?

saira: good q. function_call is binary and ties to the function schema. call_flow is a softer hint enum: "text", "tool_interrupt", "tool_response". it won't change function_call semantics, just gives a predictable high-level signal for routing UI and prefetching.

ana: sounds useful for the console. one compatibility concern: older clients that do strict schema validation might reject unknown top-level fields. do we plan to add it behind a feature flag?

saira: yeah thinking default-off on hosted for a week, then enable. we'll also document as optional. i'll add to the API changelog and SDKs.

mike: small nit — for streaming deltas we need to decide where this appears. currently we put function_call pieces in delta.payload.function_call. do we put call_flow in delta.meta or delta.type?

saira: proposal: include in the envelope meta, e.g.\n```\n{"delta_type":"content","content":"hello","meta":{"call_flow":"text"}}\n```
so it doesn't interleave with content tokens and is easy to parse.

kevin: that seems fine. just document that meta is optional and might be omitted for some deltas. also we should confirm no size/perf penalty when meta is absent.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by @saira — canary windows: 1h starting 2025-09-14T22:00Z.

tim: can someone add a regression test that fails when older clients break on unknown fields? maybe a quick e2e that runs the Node SDK with strict json schema validation turned on.

ana: i'll add a test in the SDK repo. PR draft: #4287. plan: SDK will ignore unknown top-level fields by default but we add a strict mode.

saira: thanks. i'll open the platform PR for the API change and include: change note, rollout flag, streaming sample, and a migration note for on-prem.

kevin: one more thought: for Dedicated/private customers that pin model variants, we should allow them to opt-out of call_flow entirely (config flag) so they get byte-for-byte same responses as before.

saira: agreed — will add a config toggle and mention in release notes.

mike: code check-in ping @saira — can you add a small comment in the delta encoder where meta is serialized so we can find it for perf audits?

saira: yep will add. putting the PR link here when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
